name: UI Tweaker
description: Move and scale any node of the game's interface with the mouse, then copy the C++ that puts it there

issues.info: Report bugs on GitHub or in the Discord server

toggle-key.name: Edit mode
toggle-key.description: Turns the edit mode on and off. In it, the mouse picks, moves and scales the nodes of the screen instead of pressing them, and <cy>Ctrl+C</c> copies the C++ for the selected one. It works in text fields too, so a letter key would turn it on while typing

snap.name: Snapping
snap.description: A dragged node snaps its edges and its center to the screen's, its parent's and its siblings' within 3 points, with the guides drawn. Hold <cy>Ctrl</c> to drag without it

logger-pins.name: Pinned in Improved Logger
logger-pins.description: With <cy>Improved Logger</c>: the selected node and the count of edited nodes pinned in its console, and a marker when code is copied. Every edit and the copied code are in the log either way

grid.name: Grid
grid.description: A dragged node's position, as its code writes it from the closest edge or center of the screen or its parent, goes in steps of this many points, so the code's numbers are round: <cy>winSize.width / 2 + 40.f</c>. The grid is drawn while dragging. Guides go first; <cy>Ctrl</c> drags freely. 0: no grid

put-back.name: Put edits back
put-back.description: While the edit mode is on, a screen made again, or the game started again after a rebuild, gets the edits kept for it: its nodes, found as their code finds them, are moved back, one step to undo. A node already there (its code pasted) is left as it is. Off: the edit mode changes nothing by itself. The edits are kept either way, for <cy>Ctrl+Shift+C</c>

language.name: Language
language.description: The edit mode's language. Auto: Russian on a Russian Windows, English otherwise. The generated code is in English either way

code-style.name: Code style
code-style.description: How the copied code is laid out: braces on their own lines with 2 spaces, or at the end of the line with 4 spaces as most Geode mods are written
